title: S3 callback clears PME_B0_EN after OS wake setup
description: The callback clears PME_B0_EN after OS wake setup, which can defeat the internal-controller wake policy. The exact bit clear is C0.
not_established: The board's actual decoder is untested.
remediation: Selective S3-only PE and v3 ROM experiments keep the common preparation and the S4/S5 behavior. C1 local policy, C2 physical wake. The changed LZMA properties fit the original slot. The broad v2 bypass stays historical, C3.
